Spatial controls for every cell of a raster, in one call

Source: R/grid.R
grid_controls.Rd

The grid counterpart of static_controls() and the normals of time_varying_controls(): population density of the surrounding cells, climate normals and other layers, as one raster.

Usage

grid_controls(
  pop = NULL,
  radius_m = c(5000, 10000),
  climate = NULL,
  years = 30,
  stats = c("mean", "sd", "cv"),
  layers = NULL,
  kind = NULL,
  fact = NULL,
  filename = "",
  overwrite = FALSE,
  wopt = list(),
  control = controls_control()
)

Arguments

pop

A population (count) raster with one layer.

radius_m

Radii in metres for the population density.

climate

Optional named list of climate rasters (paths or SpatRasters), e.g. list(pre = chirps).

years

Number of years, counted back from the end of each series, for the normals.

stats

Statistics of the normals: any of "mean", "sd", "cv", "min", "max", "median", "sum".

layers

Optional named list of other single-layer rasters.

kind

Optional named character vector of layer kinds.

fact

Optional aggregation factor for layers, as in terra::aggregate().

filename

Optional GeoTIFF to write the result to.

overwrite

Overwrite filename when it exists.

wopt

Options for writing, as in terra::writeRaster().

control

Further options, see controls_control().

Value

A SpatRaster with one layer per control; with dry_run, NULL.

Details

  • With pop, pop_density_<r>km is the population within each radius divided by the land area within it (cells where pop is missing count for neither), in people per square kilometre. A radius of 0 gives the cell's own density, pop_density. On longitude/latitude rasters the circle is measured in kilometres at the raster's mean latitude.

  • With climate, a named list of rasters, <name>_<stat> are the statistics over the last years years of each series, computed with calc_par(); a coefficient of variation of temperatures is computed on kelvin.

  • With layers, a named list of single-layer rasters, each is added, and aggregated by fact when given: averaged, summed or by majority, following its kind (see static_controls()).

Rasters on different grids are resampled onto the first one (bilinear for continuous layers, nearest for categorical ones, sums for counts), with a message.

See also

static_controls(), time_varying_controls(), grid_indicators()

Examples

template <- terra::rast(system.file("extdata", "tmax_daily.tif",
                                    package = "c4e"))[[1]]
pop <- terra::rast(template, vals = seq(100, 3600, by = 100))
grid_controls(pop = pop, radius_m = c(0, 50000))
#> ℹ grid_controls
#>   population density within 0, 50 km
#> class       : SpatRaster
#> size        : 6, 6, 2  (nrow, ncol, nlyr)
#> resolution  : 0.2, 0.2  (x, y)
#> extent      : 30, 31.2, -1, 0.2  (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
#> coord. ref. : lon/lat WGS 84 (EPSG:4326)
#> source(s)   : memory
#> varnames    : pop (c4e:)
#>               pop (c4e:)
#> names       : pop_density, pop_density_50km
#> min values  :    0.203102,         1.447109
#> max values  :    7.312554,         6.068171
#> unit        : per km2
#> time (days) : 2021-01-01
